label_policy.definition: adequate iff the plan of correction materially covers resident-specific harm, affected population, systemic prevention, monitoring, responsible party, and credible completion; not_adequate iff material remediation elements are missing or only generic.

feedback_policy.category: ftag_group, severity band, and adequacy subtype
feedback_policy.full_text: covered elements, missing elements, and adjudicated adequacy rationale
feedback_policy.external_text: CMS correction metadata, treated as weak outcome metadata rather than gold adequacy

risks: Correction-date metadata is too skewed to serve as the main adequacy label.
The plan itself is both response and corrective artifact, so evidence is less separable than SEC amended filings.
paper_claim: The proposed framework effectively adapts the CMS deficiency-to-plan adequacy review process, ensuring that the evaluation of corrective actions is both rigorous and contextually relevant.
